## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-5005. The issue was that Prometheus's PersistentVolume had run out of storage space at 03:02:44 UTC, causing metric collection to fail and resulting in gaps in Grafana dashboards. The logs clearly showed "no space left on device" errors when trying to write to the write-ahead log. I provided the observability team with a solution: expand the PersistentVolumeClaim to a larger size using Kubernetes's volume expansion feature, which their storage class supports and will allow the ext4 filesystem to expand online while Prometheus is running.
